CORRECTED 2026-08-30, and the correction is the reason the compiler_only_output rows are deadstrip-data rather than plain deadstrip. The note this replaces claimed daObjCannonShutter_c's _ZTI/_ZTS were NOT data-verifiable because the ROM carried a COINED RTTI name -- it then gave the same spelling for both sides and called it a length mismatch, which is self-refuting. MEASURED by reading extracted/overlays/overlay_0002.bin directly (ov002 base 0x02004060): _ZTS20daObjCannonShutter_c at ov002:0x02109cfc is the byte string '20daObjCannonShutter_c' -- the genuine Itanium length-prefixed spelling of this class's own decomp name, not a coined one. _ZTI20daObjCannonShutter_c at ov002:0x02109cf0 reads [0x0209a764, 0x02109cfc, 0x021089ec]: the __si_class_type_info vtable+8, a pointer to that same _ZTS, and _ZTI10dBgActor_c -- so the cartridge itself states the direct base is dBgActor_c. _ZTV20daObjCannonShutter_c's symbols.txt address 0x02109d38 is the vtable's ADDRESS POINT; the two header words (offset-to-top 0, typeinfo 0x02109cf0) sit at 0x02109d30, which is why Spawn stores (_ZTV20daObjCannonShutter_c + 2). Slot 0 is 0x020bcc20 (InitResources) and slot 3 is 0x020bc9b0 (CleanupResources), matching the header's slot comments. Because every one of these records has a real ROM home outside this entry's claimed .text range, they are deadstrip-data and romdata_check proves them word-by-word with relocations resolved.

Legacy src/_ZN20daObjCannonShutter_cD0Ev.cpp and src/_ZN20daObjCannonShutter_cD1Ev.cpp were BOTH already real out-of-line daObjCannonShutter_c::~daObjCannonShutter_c(){} definitions -- a plain D0/D1 collapse redefinition (same shape as VirtualDoor/#1725), not the mwcc ICE the other pilots in this series hit. Deleted the D0 copy, kept D1; the compiler emits D0 itself, byte-identical to the ROM.

Legacy src/daObjCannonShutter_c_Spawn.c already referenced this project's own _ZTV20daObjCannonShutter_c symbol (not a coined alias), so linkcheck --partial reached genuine 8/8 contribution-equivalence and PARTIAL-LINK-VERIFIED cleanly -- same clean outcome as Seaweed/#1728, confirmed by reading the legacy files before writing any code.

ONE ABI SEAM CANNOT BE WRITTEN AS A MEMBER CALL, and it is measured, not assumed. InitResources reaches dBgW_KcMbg::SetFile, whose third parameter is a by-value Fix12<int> -- a bare aggregate with no constructor (include/math/Fix12.h), so materialising one costs stack traffic the ROM does not spend. Written as mMeshCollider.SetFile(...), build/final_link.o.xMAP showed '020BCC20 000000B8 .text daObjCannonShutter_c::InitResources()' against the cartridge's 0xAC. Those 12 bytes pushed daObjCannonShutter_c_Spawn to 0x020BCCD8 (ROM 0x020BCCCC) and overflowed this entry's own range end 0x020BCCFC; because ov002 is the overlay every later overlay loads behind, ov002 growing shifted 69 modules and module fidelity fell to 20/106. The call keeps the mangled spelling for that reason and that reason only. Same wall for dBgActor_c::IsClsnInRangeOnScreen(Fix12<int>, Fix12<int>), which src/actors/daObjPushblock_c.cpp already spells mangled for the identical cause.
